news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹79.52 (vs ₹57.74 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹79.52 (up from ₹57.74 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹16.3b (up 47% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹1.43b (up 53% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 8.8% (up from 8.4% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue.

news.title: Rajesh Power Services Limited Recommends Final Dividend for the Financial Year 2025-26
news.body: Rajesh Power Services Limited at its Board of Directors meeting held on April 23, 2026 approved the recommendation of Final Dividend of 10% on Equity Shares of the Company for the Financial Year 2025-26 i.e. INR 1/- (Rupee one only) per Equity Share of Face Value of INR 10/- (Rupees Ten Only) each, for the Financial Year ended March 31, 2026, subject To Approve the Shareholders at the ensuing Seventeen Annual General Meeting ("17" AGM") of the Company.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.2% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk High level of non-cash earnings (58% accrual ratio). Minor Risk Share price has been volatile over the past 3 months (8.2% average weekly change).
